findings.detail: The generated source proves accrued_fees/pending_reg_taf_fees=0 only at its captured observation time. finalize_costs re-reads the account, but validates only identity/cash and ignores fresh fee-liability fields. A newly visible pending charge can leave cash unchanged and still yield LIVE_TERMINAL_COST_FINALITY, after which Monthly _require_exit_accounting permits progression. This is a concrete integration gap for the new automatic producer, not a demand to predict future fee postings. Reproduced through the existing real restricted transport/finalizer test with fresh pending_reg_taf_fees=0.50: both initial finalization and restart returned finality and the accounting gate passed.
findings.requested_fix: For generated Monthly sources, require the fresh finalization account to have finite present accrued_fees and pending_reg_taf_fees both zero; fail closed on absent/nonzero/conflicting fields before saving finality. Preserve legacy source behavior as needed and add a source-zero/current-nonzero regression.
findings.title: Recheck current broker fee liabilities before accepting generated Monthly finality

findings.detail: The producer requires exact equality between the activity-weighted fill average and broker order filled_avg_price. Different-price fractional fills can have more precision than the broker-reported average (or a recurring weighted average), so correct fully posted activity/cash evidence is rejected indefinitely. The current partial-fill tests use equal execution prices and do not cover this. Reproduced activity average 10.666666667 versus displayed 10.666667 with cash-consistent per-fill settlements: MONTHLY_COST_ORDER_PRICE_CONFLICT. The later broker_cash_rounding_usd path explicitly claims to preserve displayed-average effects, but this equality prevents reaching it.
findings.requested_fix: Define and verify source-supported broker average representation/precision, retain exact activity economics and the displayed-average delta separately, reject changes beyond that explicit contract, and test unequal-price partial fills. Do not introduce a blanket epsilon or silently fit cash.
findings.title: Handle documented displayed-average precision for real partial fills

limitations: Only local deterministic fixture transport was exercised; no live broker execution, scheduler, full server runner or deployment acceptance.
Allocation conservation and immutable restart paths passed the focused suite; real per-fill cash-rounding and displayed-average conventions still need source-backed acceptance.
Explicit accounting fee allocation is not broker per-order fee attribution.
No claim of future late-adjustment impossibility; fresh visible liabilities must still block current finalization.
scope: First review of new owned-book cost producer, cash-anchor addition and finalizer rounding integration only. No re-review of collector/day fixes.
